The National Archives and Records Administration invites you to join our partners at the Richard Nixon Foundation in honoring the memory of 9/11.
On September 11, 2025, the 24th anniversary of the 9/11 terrorist attacks, a ceremony will be held at the Nixon Library to pay tribute to the victims.
The ceremony is scheduled from 11:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.
This event is free of charge, but please note that the ticket does not grant access to the museum galleries.
For additional information, visit the Foundation's Remembering 9/11 webpage.
Due to the shutdown of the federal government, National Archives facilities are closed.
In addition, National Archives websites and social media accounts are not being updated or monitored, and activities are canceled, with some exceptions.
